# The display-name cache version gains an explicit preference default before generated accessor use

The new static preference list declares mail.displayname.version as int32_t with value 0 and mirror always, plus condensed-address and collapsed-thread tag-color Boolean defaults. The view reads generated accessors rather than fetching a pref service for each value. Its cached display-name representation still records version|displayname and checks the version before reuse. The changed address-book assertion expects initial value 0 instead of the missing-pref sentinel. This establishes declarations, caller names and a written assertion; the mirror generator, live preference propagation and cache invalidation were not run or fully traced. Do not confuse mirror always with a startup-only/once contract.

Scope: Thread-view static preference migration.
